messages.subject: [genoPlotR-help] Your help with genoPlotR package
messages.body_plain:
Dear Tuan,

Your questions are a bit too general for me to answer? 
I can?t really teach you R, but here is a list of very useful resources to start with. I?d recommend R for beginners by Emanuel Paradis, it?s quite good:
https://cran.r-project.org/other-docs.html

If you have more precise questions, with concrete code and data, don?t hesitate to contact me again. 

Best regards,

Lionel
